carryReasons.unknown-instance-method: Glade accepts unknown instance methods on records; the org rejects new CronTrigger().getNextFireTime(), System.CronTrigger and SchedulableContext.getNextFireTime() at compile time; needs a general checker rule for unknown instance methods on SObject/system types (B59+/classify the one shot baselines and the six vetted candidate repos follow-up)
carryReasons.core-system-fields: CronTrigger describe lists LastModifiedDate and SystemModstamp in addition to the 14 native fields because ensureCoreSystemFields adds them to every object; filtering by the public catalog would change describes of ~280 to 395 standard objects (History, Share and others); needs rows for which core system fields native describes list
carryReasons.anonymous-abort: The anonymous helper aborts its scheduled job in a finally block; local anonymous System.abortJob of a recorded scheduled job is an unsupported async boundary (the same boundary the cron next-fire family carries); the @IsTest twins assert the same schedules; needs a native-backed anonymous abort lifecycle

rows.testClass: @IsTest private class CronClockObservation{private class ContextJob implements Schedulable{public void execute(SchedulableContext context){throw new CronClockSchedule.ClockCaptureException('CRON_ACCESSOR|'+JSON.serialize(CronClockSchedule.clock(context.getNextFireTime(),false)));}}@IsTest static void observe(){String jobName='clock-071-i-o-'+String.valueOf(Crypto.getRandomLong());Map<String,Object> v=new Map<String,Object>();v.put('context',CronClockSchedule.facts());Test.startTest();List<String> scheduleContext=CronClockSchedule.facts();String job=System.schedule(jobName,'0 0 17 28 5 ? 2027',new ContextJob());try{Test.stopTest();v=CronClockSchedule.afterStop(job);}catch(Exception e){if(e.getMessage().startsWith('CRON_ACCESSOR|')){v.put('accessor',JSON.deserializeUntyped(e.getMessage().substring(14)));v.put('effect','callback-framed');}else{v.put('status','FIXTURE_ACCESSOR_MESSAGE');v.put('exceptionType',e.getTypeName());v.put('exceptionMessage',e.getMessage());}}finally{v.put('outerContext',scheduleContext);try{System.abortJob(job);}catch(Exception cleanup){v.put('cleanup','abort-failed');}}System.assert(false,'CRON_RESULT|C31CR_071|observe|'+JSON.serialize(v));}}
